questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

p _ _ u o p q t _ _ _ q _ u o p q _ u _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: p _ _ u o p q t _ _ _ q _ u o p q _ u _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) qtuoptto → p **__q__** **__t__** u o / p q t **__u__** **__o__** / __**p**__ q __**t**__ u o / p q __**t**__ u __**o**__

Here, 'Option 1' followed a pattern.

Option 2) tquoptto → p **__t__** **__q__** u o / p q t __u__ __o__ / __p__ q __t__ u o / p q __t__ u __o__

Option 3) tqouptot → p **__t__** **__q__** u o / p q t **__o__** **__u__** / __p__ q __t__ u o / p q **__o__** u **__t__**

Option 4) qtouptto → p __q__ __t__ u o / p q t **__o__** **__u__** / __p__ q __t__ u o / p q __t__ u __o__

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png]

Given Expression: ‘C - D ÷ E × F + G’

C is the daughter of D, D is the brother of E, E is the son of F, F is the Mother of G.

questions.question: Six friends E, F, G, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S sits second to the right of F. F sits second to the right of G. Only F sits between R and E. E is an immediate neighbour of S. How many people sit between T and R when counted from the right of R?
questions.solution:
Given:

Six friends E, F, G, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) S sits second to the right of F.

2) F sits second to the right of G.

3) Only F sits between R and E.

4) E is an immediate neighbour of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08e650c039b7e1795254f6704a1eaf2ebff5e2b07a2c744bc2a659162e71c47d.png] 

So, three people sit between T and R when counted from the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (1)".**
